summary: Keeps protected plugin publication aligned with the immutable ORAS setup action and the versions declared by each source package.
userImpact: Protected installer, Plugin Manager, and Helm chart publication no longer fails before verification because of a setup-action release-catalog mismatch.
Plugin package publication validates the current source manifests instead of a stale hard-coded version table.

notes: This release-workflow correction does not change application data or migrations.

security: The setup action remains pinned by commit and the workflow continues to verify and sign every immutable toolchain subject.
rollback: Restore an explicit ORAS version only when the pinned setup action's frozen catalog is updated to include it.
validation: Run release-note and workflow policy checks, pack and validate all four public plugin packages, then execute both protected publication workflows from the exact merged main commit.
